themes_detail.label: Street Noise Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints surged to 60 this week compared to a 11.5 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 422% spike (z-score: 7.02)—suggesting a new source of disruption emerged in East Flatbush within the past 7 days.
evidence: 60 noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 11.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (422% increase)
Z-score of 7.02 indicates statistically significant anomaly with high severity rating
Timing suggests acute trigger rather than chronic problem—spike appeared suddenly within past 7 days
reporting_angles: Investigate whether construction, special event, or new commercial activity (bar, club, food vendor) launched this week
Interview affected residents on affected streets; map complaint clusters to identify epicenter
Cross-reference with DOB permit data (308 alteration filings in 90 days) to see if permitted work is underway without noise mitigation

themes_detail.label: Water Quality Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Water quality complaints jumped to 3 last week versus a 0.1 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 2300% spike (z-score: 8.69)—indicating a potential drinking water contamination or discoloration event affecting East Flatbush residents.
evidence: 3 water quality complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (2300% increase, z-score: 8.69)
Highest z-score spike in the dataset, indicating severe statistical anomaly
Water issue also appears in baseline complaints (Water Leak: 566 total; Plumbing: 869 total), suggesting broader water system stress
reporting_angles: Contact NYC DEP immediately for water quality test results, boil water advisories, or main break reports in East Flatbush
Interview residents who filed complaints to describe water appearance, smell, taste; identify affected blocks
Check if main infrastructure work (related to 308 DOB filings) damaged water lines or introduced contamination

themes_detail.label: Dead Animals Surge
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints increased to 6 this week compared to a 1.4 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 336% jump (z-score: 5.4)—pointing to a potential public health issue or pest outbreak in East Flatbush neighborhoods.
evidence: 6 dead animal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average (336% increase, z-score: 5.4)
Coincides with dumpster spike (4 complaints this week vs. 0.4 avg) and unsanitary conditions in baseline (989 total complaints)
Suggests interconnected sanitation and pest control crisis unfolding now
reporting_angles: File FOIL request with DSNY for dead animal pickup logs and dumpster violation citations in East Flatbush this week
Interview NYC Health Department about possible disease vector concern (rat-borne illness, disease carriers)
Visit neighborhoods where complaints clustered; photograph conditions and interview residents about visible pest activity

themes_detail.label: Illegal Tree Damage Spike
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage complaints jumped to 3 last week versus a 0.2 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 1100% spike (z-score: 6.35)—suggesting coordinated tree removal, vandalism, or clearing activity tied to development or construction in East Flatbush.
evidence: 3 illegal tree damage complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (1100% increase, z-score: 6.35)

82 new building permits + 174 alteration permits filed in past 90 days; tree damage could signal unpermitted site clearing
reporting_angles: Identify which 3 tree damage complaints and locate on map; cross-reference with ULURP sites and active DOB permits
Check NYC Parks enforcement records for violations; determine if tree damage is permitted or illegal
Interview community about Constellation CB 17 development—is site prep beginning? Are developers removing trees without community notice?

themes_detail.label: Dumpster & Sanitation Breakdown
themes_detail.summary: Dumpster complaints surged to 4 this week versus a 0.4 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 967% spike (z-score: 7.49)—coinciding with a broader sanitation crisis indicated by 989 unsanitary condition complaints in the baseline and dead animal spike.
evidence: 4 dumpster complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (967% increase, z-score: 7.49)
Correlates with dead animal spike (6 complaints this week) and unsanitary conditions (989 total complaints in 90-day baseline)
Suggests systemic DSNY collection failure or overflow in specific neighborhoods
reporting_angles: Contact DSNY for collection schedules and missed pickup logs in East Flatbush this week; identify if routes were skipped
Map the 4 dumpster complaints and 6 dead animal complaints to see if they cluster on same blocks
Interview residents and business owners: Are dumpsters overflowing? Is trash collection irregular? Any visible rodent activity?
